headline: Silver Falls 1.18 Percent To 53.65 As Gold Eases 0.54 Percent
narrative: Silver fell 1.18 percent to 53.65, and the precious-metals pipe gave up ground. Gold eased 0.54 percent to 4,052.6, so money left both precious-metals pipes together. Crude oil rose 3.44 percent to 103.34 and copper rose 0.7 percent to 6.67, taking the bid the metals released.
author: jordan
